sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
Back at home, none of the team is able to bond with the Amulet of Will. They translate a page from the journal and reveal a clue that says [[King Solomon]] was the last Seeker to have the Legendary Titan of Spirit. His treasures are locked in the Mines of Ophir that once belonged to Queen Sheba. The heroes travel to Ethiopia, and a friendly guide, [[Otto]], takes them to the desert to find Queen Sheba’s tomb.

Meanwhile, the Professor and Rassimov pursue them personally, for they know the stakes are high and it is critical that Dante’s team do not get their hands on another Legendary Titan.

On their way to the tomb, the heroes evade Suits and angry villagers but are caught in a desert sandstorm. [[Suits]] attack during the sandstorm, and Zhalia and Otto are separated from the team. In their desert search for Zhalia, Lok, Sophie, and Dante stumble upon a tomb with a giant snake-shaped entrance. They accidentally activate its guardian Titans, the three Colossi. Zhalia and Otto are captured by the Professor, and he uses his mind-control ring to force the guide to do his bidding. He then turns the ring to Zhalia who screams in agony.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Lok's hatred of spiders from "The Bookshop Hunter" is referenced as he asks Otto if there will be any poisonous spiders in the desert, to which the latter humorously replies, "I thought we were looking for snakes!".
• This marks the first time (out of a total of five times) an episode's title is said by a character in that same episode. [Reference: At Dante's house, in the beggining of the episode, Sophie reads from Eathon's journal: "When you observe the house of the sleeping kings, look north across the sands of Axum and behold the Golden Asp". At the end of the episode, Lok also says "Wow. The Golden Asp. That's it!" when he spots the structure.]

full_text:
Temple of Poseidon, Greece

Lok, Dante, Sophie and Zhalia manage to pass four tests, and get into the Casterwill residence in Atlantis. Lok finds out that his father didn't manage to get there and he might never find him. When the Organization attacks, Lok unleashes all his anger against the agents, defeating Rassimov. Sophie reveals her feelings for Lok, and the Huntik team gets the Amulet of Will.

Synopsis

With the Amulet of Will now in their possession, the gang decides to decipher additional clues from Eathon's journal containing the location of the final two Legendary Titans. The next Legendary Titan is located in Ethopia, Africa, and this time The Professor will personally attend to the issue.

Plot

Back at home, none of the team is able to bond with the Amulet of Will. They translate a page from the journal and reveal a clue that says King Solomon was the last Seeker to have the Legendary Titan of Spirit. His treasures are locked in the Mines of Ophir that once belonged to Queen Sheba. The heroes travel to Ethiopia, and a friendly guide, Otto, takes them to the desert to find Queen Sheba’s tomb.

Meanwhile, the Professor and Rassimov pursue them personally, for they know the stakes are high and it is critical that Dante’s team do not get their hands on another Legendary Titan.

On their way to the tomb, the heroes evade Suits and angry villagers but are caught in a desert sandstorm. Suits attack during the sandstorm, and Zhalia and Otto are separated from the team. In their desert search for Zhalia, Lok, Sophie, and Dante stumble upon a tomb with a giant snake-shaped entrance. They accidentally activate its guardian Titans, the three Colossi. Zhalia and Otto are captured by the Professor, and he uses his mind-control ring to force the guide to do his bidding. He then turns the ring to Zhalia who screams in agony.

Trivia

• Lok's hatred of spiders from "The Bookshop Hunter" is referenced as he asks Otto if there will be any poisonous spiders in the desert, to which the latter humorously replies, "I thought we were looking for snakes!".
• This marks the first time (out of a total of five times) an episode's title is said by a character in that same episode. [Reference: At Dante's house, in the beggining of the episode, Sophie reads from Eathon's journal: "When you observe the house of the sleeping kings, look north across the sands of Axum and behold the Golden Asp". At the end of the episode, Lok also says "Wow. The Golden Asp. That's it!" when he spots the structure.]
